rules.description: Rick and any friendly models within his Kill Zone at the start of the Melee phase add 1 white die to their melee defense rolls.

rules.description: Rick and all Bruisers in his group add 1 red die to Defense while wounded. If they are also Bitten, they add one red die to melee attack rolls too. All Survivors with the Prison Advisor subtitle may use leader abilities even if Rick is the leader.

rules.name: Unstable
rules.description: At the star of each of Morgan`s activations, before Panic Checks, roll a blue die. This is how many Actions Morgan may take this turn.

rules.name: Just a Kid...
rules.description: If a Survivor wishes to target Billy & Ben with a ranged attack, it must first roll a black die. On a shield it may take the shot as normal. On a blank, it has second thoughts and must choose a different target, or a different Action.

rules.name: Think of the Children...
rules.description: When Billy & Ben are in the Kill Zone of a friendly Allen, Donna, Dale or Andrea model, that model may re-roll one die per melee attack or defense roll.

rules.name: Healer
rules.description:
As an Action, Alice may restore 1 red die health lost earlier in the game, to herself or a friendly model in her Kill Zone. Alice may use Bandages on any other model within her Kill Zone.
When Alice uses any item of equipment that restores lost wounds, she restores 1 extra wound.

rules.name: Medical Professional
rules.description:
As an Action, Stevens may restore 1 white die health lost earlier in the game, to himself or a friendly model in his Kill Zone. Stevens may use Bandages on any other model within his Kill Zone.
When Stevens uses any item that restores lost wounds, he restores 1 extra wound.

rules.name: Police Brutality
rules.description: When Rick is on the winning side in melee, his side gains one free !.

rules.name: Rallying Cry
rules.description: Panicking friendly models within 6" of Rick may roll an extra yellow die and choose their preferred result.

rules.name: Leader Ability: Master Strategist
rules.description:
Roll a white die at the start of each of Rick`s activations.
Distribute that many extra Actions amongst the Survivors in the group yet to act (including Rick). No model may receive more than one bonus Action.

rules.name: Cautious
rules.description:
Rick gains an extra Action while the Threat is All Quit or Low.
When the Threat Level is High, roll a black die when Rick is activated. On a shield, he acts normally. On a blank, he loses one Action.

rules.name: Blood is Thicker than Water
rules.description: While Carl Grimes is within his Kill Zone, both Rick and Carl add one white die to their melee defense rolls.

rules.name: Leader Ability: Protector
rules.description:
As an Action, Rick may add a red die to the Defense of all friendly models (not including himself) in his Kill Zone for the rest of the turn.
Rick may not attack (ranged or melee) enemy models in any turn he uses this ability.
He may defend in melee if required.

rules.name: Leader Ability: Mind Games
rules.description:
Once per game, Dale may steal the Initiative from his opponent. If both groups contain a Leader with this ability, the Initative may be stolen back again!

All survivors with the Prison Advisor subtitle may use their leader abilities even if Dale is the leader.

rules.name: Slippery
rules.description: At the start of a combat in which Glenn is engaged, before any dice are rolled, he may roll one Black die for each enemy in base contact. On a Shield, the model is moved 1" away from Glenn, exactly as if it had been pushed back.

At the start of the game, take one White die for each Prison Advisor in the group. As an Action, Tyreese may add one of these dice to a friendly model's subsequent roll of any type.

All survivors with the Prison Advisor subtitle may use their leader abilities even if Tyreese is the leader.

rules.name: Rock Bottom
rules.description: At the start of each of Maggie's activations, roll one blue die. On one hit, her Nerve is Low; on two hits, her Nerve is Medium; on three hits, her Nerve is High.

rules.name: Rebellious
rules.description: If Maggie starts her activation more than 10" away from the group's Leader, roll one black die. On a Shield symbol, she gains an extra Action.

rules.name: Leader Ability: Stealth Tactics
rules.description: Glenn and all Runners in his group may each roll one black after performing a Run. On a Shield, they make no NOISE.

rules.name: Resource Gatherer
rules.description: Glenn does not need to use an Action to Search, provided he is in contact with a Supply counter and not engaged.

rules.name: New-Found Responsibilities
rules.description: If Maggie Greene and/or Sophia are within Glenn's Kill Zone at the start of the Action phase, reduce the current Threat by 1.

rules.name: Covert Maneuvers
rules.description: When an enemy performs a ranged attack against Rosita or a friendly model in her Kill Zone, each blank they roll adds one red to the target's defense roll.

rules.name: Level Headed
rules.description: Rosita, and all friendly models within her Kill Zone, may reroll the Panic die. You must accept the second result even if it is worse than the first.

rules.name: Living Resource
rules.description: Eugene may spend an Action to reload any ranged weapon in his Kill Zone.

rules.name: Good Liar
rules.description: As an Action, Eugene may swap his Nerve with one model within 3", friend or foe, for the remainder of the turn.

rules.name: Extremely Intelligent
rules.description: As an Action, Eugene may discard any number of Supply counters to immediately choose one Special Item Equipment card from your collection, worth up to 5 points for each counter discarded. In addition, in a map campaign, if Eugene survives a game you may re-roll the die for number of new faction markers placed.

rules.name: Untrusting
rules.description: Rick may not benefit from any special rules or leader abilities of any friendly model except for Carl Grimes.

rules.name: Go for the Throat
rules.description: Rick treats Quiet! and Scream! results on the Panic die as Berserk! results. In addition, if there is a friendly model in his Kill Zone that has taken damage, he may re-roll blanks in melee.

rules.name: Unstable
rules.description: At the start of each of Rick's activations, before Panic is rolled, roll one blue die. This is how many Actions Rick may take this turn.

rules.name: Someone to Save
rules.description: Friendly models in Sophia's Kill Zone may take a third Action each turn. Friendly models in a multiple melee involving Sophia may re-roll blanks.

rules.name: She's Not Dead
rules.description: Sophia believes Glenn and Maggie are her parents now. While Glenn and/or Maggie have Sophia in their Kill Zone, Sophia treats her Nerve as one level higher than usual, and Glenn and/or Maggie gain one white die to Defense.

rules.name: Ruthless Sniper
rules.description: Any model wounded but not removed from play by Andrea's ranged attacks must Panic at the start of their next activation, regardless of their Nerve.

rules.name: Supporting Fire
rules.description: If Andrea damages any enemy Survivor with a Shooting attack, and another member of Andrea's group is in their Kill Zone, that Survivor (choose if there is more than one) may take advantage of the confusion and immediately (before resolving NOISE or MAYHEM) make a single free Action of their choice.

rules.name: Skilled Negotiator
rules.description: As an Action, Aaron may target one enemy Survivor and one friendly Survivor within 6". Roll 1Black: on a Shield, target enemy must lose 1 Action in its next activation, and target friendly model gains +1 Action in its next activation.

rules.name: Moral Support
rules.description: When performing a Hold Your Nerve Action, Eric may make one additional roll for every Friendly Rick's Group Survivor in his Kill Zone, up to a maximum of three rolls.

rules.name: Good Neighbor
rules.description: If a friendly model within Heath's Kill Zone is wounded by an enemy attack, both Heath and that model add 1White to their Defense for the remainder of the turn.

rules.name: Resource Gatherer
rules.description: Heath does not need to use an Action to Search, provided he is in contact with a Supply counter and not engaged (and no unengaged enemies are in contact with the counter).

rules.name: Protective Father
rules.description: If Carl Grimes is within Rick's Kill Zone at the start of the Action phase, reduce the current Threat by 1.

rules.name: Leader Ability: Remake the World
rules.description: While the Threat Level is High, friendly models with the Rick's Group faction icon gain 1Red to their Defense rolls.

rules.name: Preferred Weapon
rules.description: When using Rick's Hatchet, Rick may exchange one die from his melee attack pool for 1Blue.
